name: TCM-Vision-Benchmark-Augmented
description: TCM-Vision-Benchmark-Augmented is a vision dataset focused on Traditional Chinese Medicine visual diagnosis tasks (e.g., tongue, face, or other clinical image-based signs) with augmented data to improve robustness. It measures model performance on classification and segmentation tasks relevant to TCM diagnostic features and supports research on automated TCM assessment. The benchmark aims to facilitate safe, clinically-aware vision models in TCM contexts.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific medical vision dataset with emerging interest from researchers working at the intersection of AI and Traditional Chinese Medicine.
